evidence: Physical ratios and explicit normalized delivered-cost and recurring-demand sensitivities. No product qualification, inferred gravity-to-cost multiplier, industrial revenue forecast or new GWP addition.

environment.comparison_gas: Same composition and temperature on Earth and Moon to isolate gravity and pressure; no temperature change to inherited atmosphere inventories.
environment.separate_diagnostic_rule: Initial pump work/time assume negligible additional gas. The independently chosen fixed process-load example gives the required inlet speed and extra ideal discharge work; it is not asserted to be compatible with the initial1m3/s pump.

centrifuges.rule: Chosen tolerances and speeds. Radial gravity gradient and maximum transverse Coriolis ratio are diagnostics, not compulsory constraints on every recipe. Axial motion and process orientation can reduce Coriolis effects; shared orbital infrastructure can lower costs.

cost_screen.normalization: One specified qualified product unit per year is a normalization only. No product mass, actual throughput or factory price is inferred. Costs include levelized capital service and use a common real U.
cost_screen.boundary: Shares are hypothetical disjoint costs. Gravity-step savings are scenarios. Array reproduces the same partial-gravity recipe and removes only ambient-vacuum pressure/gas/cycle costs; internal process gas, contamination and feed containment remain in other. Annual site service is disjoint and can include rotation and ordinary-pressure accommodation. An alternative free-fall recipe may be still cheaper.
cost_screen.pressure_component_rule: Initial-gas evacuation, fixed-geometry ideal buckling and no-added-gas constant-speed cycle factors affect only their named shares. Internal process pumping remains in other. Actual costs need plant design and may follow different functions.

renewal.rule: Mature stock replacement with no growth. Award share is a customer assumption, not predicted from cost. Carrier40-year life is inherited; array structure50/100-year lives are new sensitivities. Spending already belongs to replacement/CFC and is not added to GDP.

boundaries: Mature lunar pressure remains locked at1.2atm. A1atm comparison changes no design choice and would still require artificial vacuum.
Gravity is not a manufacturing-cost multiplier. Capillary, stress and convection scalings preserve their fixed material, geometry or mechanism assumptions; some processes become slower or harder.
The array can choose microgravity, local centrifuges or large rotating facilities. No arbitrary charge for all orbital industry is adopted.
Local construction/use advantages are distinct from exported material quality. Launch acceleration, destination loads, packing and delivered cost remain product requirements.
Normalized cost screens do not establish output, margin, earned cash or empirical lunar gains. Renewable demand is not new world output.
